## Checklist

- [ ] This targets `main` and has a focused scope.
- [ ] New or changed behavior has tests.
- [ ] `pnpm lint`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm format`, and `pnpm build:check` pass.
- [ ] No credentials, unpublished structures, private paths, or agent-session evidence are included.
- [ ] User-visible strings are localized.
- [ ] The commit is signed off.
